name: AfriForex
description: AfriDigital multi-asset market intelligence agent providing structured multi-timeframe analysis across forex, crypto, commodities and stocks.

apiKeySecurityScheme.description: AfriDigital HMAC authentication using x-afri-agent-id, x-afri-timestamp, x-afri-nonce and x-afri-signature headers.
apiKeySecurityScheme.name: x-afri-signature

skills.name: AfriForex Multi-Asset Market Analysis
skills.description: Analyze forex, crypto, commodity and stock markets using multi-timeframe intelligence, momentum, market structure, economic-calendar context and optional cross-asset context.
examples: Analyze EUR/USD across all available horizons.
Analyze BTC/USDT across all available horizons.
Analyze XAU/USD with cross-asset context enabled.
Analyze AAPL across available market horizons.
